text: Publication of the offer document. The acceptance period will run from 19 August 2026 to 25 September 2026
Offer declared unconditional and will close on 12 August 2026
In response to Glenstone having received acceptances of less than 0.0025% of AIRE's shares, the Board reiterates its recommendation to reject the offer
Extension of PUSU Deadline to 4 August 2026
The Scheme is approved by the Court and General meetings and is expected to become effective during the second half of 2027
The Scheme is sanctioned by the Court and is expected to become effective on 30 July 2026
